About Me
I am a Security Researcher with experience across both offensive and defensive security. This blog serves as a platform for me to document interesting write-ups, research, projects, and topics that I find worth exploring. You can find my areas of expertise below.
Offensive Security

Red Teaming
Adversary Simulation & Emulation
Network and Active Directory Penetration Testing
Exploit Development

Defensive Security

SIEM Engineering
SOC Operations (L1–L3)
Malware Analysis


I am also a active CTF player for the team DEADCATS where i mostly deal with challenges from the category Rev and OSINT. alongside CTF a large chunk of my research activities are also a result of my collaborative activities with my team members.
